resources.string: Protection for Google Play services on HyperOS
GMS Protect Lite helps keep Google Play services available for push notifications on supported Xiaomi / HyperOS devices. Setup only takes a moment.
Allow GMS Protect Lite to start after a reboot so protection can be restored automatically.
Set GMS Protect Lite to No restrictions / Unrestricted so HyperOS does not block its boot receiver.
You can close the app. Protection will be restored automatically after reboot.
Protection is also refreshed every time you open GMS Protect Lite.
GMS Protect Lite is free and has no ads. If it helps you, you can donate to support development.

Results combine current device state with real evidence saved when Android/HyperOS actually wakes GMS Protect Lite after the MILLET list changes.

The strongest checks are passive. “System wake-up” is verified only after JobScheduler really starts GMS Protect Lite because the HyperOS MILLET setting changed. “Automatic GMS repair” is verified only after GMS was actually missing and the app restored it successfully.
